If you’d like to give

Registry

Your presence is the present — truly. But for those who have asked (and you have asked, repeatedly), here’s where we’ve set things up.

We’ve been living together for four years and don’t need much in the way of kitchen gear — but we’re hoping to slowly upgrade from the “Maya took these dishes from her college apartment” phase of our lives. We’ve also set up a small honeymoon fund: we’re heading to Portugal in October to walk around and eat seafood for two weeks, and any contribution will go directly toward a really nice dinner in Lisbon that we will think of you during.

Anything you choose to send is going to feel like a lot. Thank you, sincerely.

Gifts can be shipped directly through any of these — please do not bring them to the wedding.

CRATE&BARREL

Crate & Barrel

The everyday stuff — a real set of dinner plates, the cast iron we keep meaning to buy, a sheet pan that doesn’t warp at 425°F. The boring upgrades we’ll use every week for the next ten years.

View registry →
zola

Zola

Our main registry, with everything else — bedding, towels, the big serving platter that fits a whole roast chicken, a vintage Le Creuset in a color we’ve been eyeing for a year. A good mix of practical and aspirational.

View registry →
REI

REI

For the camping setup we want to actually use, instead of borrowing from Devon’s brother every August. A two-person tent, a real cooler, headlamps, and a French press that can survive the back of a car.

View registry →
Lisbon

Honeymoon fund

We’re going to Portugal — Lisbon, then a slow drive down the coast to the Algarve. Contributions go toward one big seafood dinner, a few nights at a guesthouse with a pool, and a very long train ride we’re excited about.

Contribute →
If a registry isn’t your style

Other meaningful options

A donation to any of the following, in our names, would mean the world.

Brooklyn Queens Land Trust

The organization that protects the community garden where we met. Without them, that lot would be condos — and we wouldn’t be here. bqlt.org

Catskill Center

A regional conservation nonprofit working on land protection and arts programming throughout the Catskills. They’ve been the quiet hands behind half the trails you’ll hike up here. catskillcenter.org

Equity for Flatbush

A tenant-organizing collective Devon has volunteered with since 2020, doing eviction defense and language-access work for residents of central Brooklyn. equityforflatbush.org

826NYC

A free creative writing program for kids in New York City public schools. Maya volunteered with the Park Slope chapter for two years and we both think it’s one of the best-run nonprofits anywhere. 826nyc.org

✦

Above all: your being there is the gift. Please don’t feel any obligation. We mean that.
